expect: A failed CREATE, DROP, or migration leaves the admin client open or the test database behind: cleanup is not in `finally`, and `remove` is never returned when migration throws.

The test database name is the configured name plus `_test_<8 chars>`, unbounded and quoted with backticks without escaping: a long DATABASE_URL name exceeds MySQL's 64-character identifier limit, and a backtick in it breaks the statement.
The previews map stores the fetch promise before it settles and never deletes it, so one failed request makes every later visit to that stack fail until reload.

`readRecords` calls `readdirSync` on every directory it is given; download-artifact leaves the directory uncreated when a run uploaded nothing, so the CI job throws ENOENT instead of reading no records.
The CLI bundles these workspace packages, and pnpm cannot pack a workspace dependency without a version, so the release pack fails.
`formatted.set(key, pending)` keeps a rejected format promise, so one failure is returned for that content for the life of the process.
